dialogs.about: 손녀와 함께 절에 갈 준비를 하며 이야기해요

lines.en: Grandma, are we going to the temple today?
Yes. We will leave after breakfast.
What do you do at the temple?
I pray there. It gives me peace.
I heard a big bell there last spring.
Yes, a monk rings it every morning.
Grandma, does the incense smell good?
Yes, it smells very good and clean.
lines.ko: 네, 아주 좋고 맑은 냄새가 나요.

lines.en: I will say a prayer for Grandpa.
Thank you, dear child. You have a kind heart.
lines.ko: 고마워요, 우리 아기. 마음이 참 곱네요.

dialogs.about: 동네 교회 앞에서 이웃을 만나 이야기해요

lines.en: Good morning. Are you going to church?
Yes. The bell is ringing now.
I came here last Sunday for the first time.
How did you feel inside?
I felt peace that day. The music was beautiful.
That's good. My faith helps me every day.
lines.ko: 좋네요. 제 믿음이 날마다 힘이 돼요.

lines.en: Do you pray at home too?
Yes, I say a short prayer every night.
Will you come again next Sunday?
Of course. Thank you for walking with me.
